findings: The card's maximum three-tick market-order deviation is never configured. QM_FrameworkInit installs the framework default of 20 points, and the EA has no later QM_EntryConfigure call to replace it with a symbol-aware three-tick ceiling.

The first eligible post-start bar can still bypass the card's spread ceiling. Strategy_NoTradeFilter tests g_strategy_cached_atr only when it is already positive at lines 135-139, but that cache is populated later inside Strategy_EntrySignal at line 177; entry then proceeds without recomputing the admission decision against the newly available ATR.

The declared 2.5% daily and 5.0% total drawdown controls do not configure the framework kill switch. QM_FrameworkInit leaves QM_KillSwitchInit at framework defaults of 3.0% daily and 0.0% total, while the EA's manual initial-equity/day-start state is process-local and resets on restart. This can erase accumulated drawdown and does not enforce the approved fail-closed capital-preservation contract.
